rules.statement: In Ghost Town, V agreed to Panam's detour after Nash and rode with her to the Raffen Shiv hideout instead of insisting on the original deal.
On the rooftop before choosing how to face Arasaka, V called Kerry and the two of them talked.
V took Reed's NUSA option instead of storming Arasaka: V boarded the FIA medical AV for the experimental surgery, with Johnny still in V's head.
V boarded the FIA medical AV on the rooftop to undergo the NUSA surgery that would remove Johnny.
On the FIA flight before the surgery, Johnny and V parted on good terms: he said they had made their peace at the oil fields and stayed with V to the end.
After waking from the two-year coma following the NUSA surgery, V called Kerry and spoke with him over the holo.
While V was at Arasaka's orbital facility after Mikoshi, V called Kerry and spoke with him.
On the Path of Glory morning, Kerry was with V at the penthouse; over coffee they talked about leaving the past behind and Kerry's plans, and he asked V to be careful.
After the Aldecaldos' assault on Arasaka Tower, V finished off the defeated Adam Smasher instead of walking away.
On the assault with Rogue, after Smasher was defeated, Johnny (in control of V's body) finished him off instead of walking away.
On the solo assault on Arasaka Tower, V shot the defeated Adam Smasher dead before moving on to Mikoshi.
In Second Conflict, Brick was back in charge at the Totentanz; V and Nancy talked with him and he let Nancy walk out with V.
In Second Conflict, Patricia ran the Totentanz; when V came for Nancy, Patricia's Maelstromers turned hostile and V had to fight them.
In Second Conflict, V copied Nancy's reporting files out of the Totentanz on Royce's turf while she kept the Maelstromers busy, and got her out.
After Kerry and the Us Cracks patched things up backstage, V suggested a group shot and took a selfie with Kerry and the band.
After the reconciliation with the Us Cracks, V went to Kerry's Off the Leash premiere party at the pachinko parlor and spent the evening there with Kerry.
After torching the Us Cracks' gear in Rebel! Rebel!, V followed Kerry to Capitán Caliente and had coffee and a talk with him there.
On Kerry's yacht in Boat Drinks, V and Kerry did not sleep together; the evening went on to the wrap-up talk instead.

Early on, Johnny told V it had not been easy for him either - V woke up in a landfill, he woke up in V's head - and proposed they help each other, starting with Rogue. It was a truce of necessity, not friendship.
After the Heist, Viktor told V that the Relic was overwriting V's consciousness with Johnny Silverhand's construct and that V had only a few weeks left.
